details:
This isn't something that will effect everyone immediately but this is something I would regard as a necessary feature.

I'm talking about something really quite subtle and basic, this is only for the sake of invite and invite+ rooms, when you want to make a private place but allow specific friends to join you.

This is worth adding without a doubt, better control of worlds and rooms to the point where some worlds can begin to be made semi-"permanent" in the future. Especially when guilds are implemented this will be more important.

The reason I am looking to see this added personally is for all the above reasons and more immediately so I can have invite only rooms that allow specific people I trust the most to come and go as they please, as well as rejoin the world without request if I'm AFK, as I have some friends that crash on a fairly regular basis and if I'm asleep(Yes in VR), I'm not going to be able to invite them back.

The way I propose this to work is through 1 of 2 ways, the first is allowing the host of a invite or invite+ room to target a player and grant them the ability to join that room at any time until the room is closed, even if they restart their game, it could be possible to let people grant that permission through friends too but I don't think that's necessary, it's also a bit clunky and confusing.

That's the most non-intrusive way but I wouldn't recommend it because it's not very future proof and it's better to add things that can be built on further as the game develops rather than adding/removing features as they're needed, (waste resources and confuse players).

The best way for this to work is to just let a player set this permission for friends when they create a room, the player would click create new instance, then if it's a invite/invite+ world a little "+" symbol will appear in a box, the player can then click this to open another interface where they can grant special permissions to friends by adding them to a list, for the purpose of this it'd probably be best to display all of a players online friends followed by their offline friends in a grid format, with a checkbox beside each players name, making it easy and fast to grant multiple people this permission before creating a room.

At the same time for the people that don't currently have a use for a feature like this might not even know it's there, which I take as another positive, there's no reason to tell or give players information that isn't relevant or they don't need to know.
title: Additional room control/permission granting!
